plan.notes: Source: UACCB 2026-2027 College Catalog, Health Professions section, Associate of Science Health Professions. Genuine term-by-term 'Suggested Course Sequence' (14+16+15+15 = 60) matches the stated credential total 60. Requirement slots are modeled as choice slots with the first-listed course from each official requirements list as the code. The seven 'Elective' slots draw from the 21-credit Program Electives pool -- the catalog does not assign courses to the slots, so generic ELECTIVE placeholders are used (not invented). Physics for Health Sciences (PHYS 20104) is a 4-credit Physical Sciences lecture option with no separate lab row in the requirements table.
